# PiTTy 1.1.1

## Recommended plugins

`rpiv-todo` is no longer recommended. Founder setup, the Settings page and both installers leave it out. An existing installation stays in place.

A plugin installed from a local checkout, such as your own fork, now counts as installed when its package name matches. Setup keeps it and no longer adds the maintained copy beside it. A local checkout that lacks files the current release needs is listed as outdated, with `update checkout`. Setup skips it and never builds or changes it.

The page says `configure` for packages that are already present and only need registering or pinning.

```sh
pitty upgrade
```

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mistrjirka/PiTTy/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1)
